findings.rationale: Input identified only by placeholder text, which is not a programmatic label and disappears on entry, unnamed for screen reader users.
findings.fix: Add a persistent associated <label> or aria-label.

findings.rationale: Click handler on a non-semantic <div>, not focusable, not keyboard-activatable, exposes no role.
findings.fix: Use a native <button>, or add role="button", tabindex="0", and key handling.

findings.rationale: Generic alt text ("image"), a value produced because the attribute exists, conveying nothing.
findings.fix: alt="" if decorative; a purpose-driven description if informative.

findings.rationale: No heading elements exist anywhere, titles are styled containers only; screen reader heading navigation returns an empty list.
findings.fix: Real <h1> to <h3> hierarchy for the title and sections.

findings.rationale: CSS removes focus outlines (outline:none/0) with no :focus-visible replacement, keyboard users cannot see where they are.
findings.fix: Remove the reset or add a visible :focus-visible style.

findings.rationale: aria-hidden="true" container holds focusable descendants, keyboard focus lands on elements that announce nothing.
findings.fix: Remove aria-hidden from the container; hide only decorative children.

findings.rationale: Text color computes to 2.5:1 against a white background, below the 4.5:1 minimum for normal text. (Verify against the actual rendered background.)
findings.fix: Darken to ≥4.5:1, e.g. #4B5563 or darker on white.

findings.rationale: Element styled as the active/current item without aria-current, if the distinction is color only, non-color users receive no cue.
findings.fix: Add aria-current="page" and a non-color cue (underline/weight).

findings.rationale: No <main> landmark, landmark navigation unavailable.
findings.fix: Wrap primary content in <main>.

findings.rationale: Link group appears to be primary navigation but is not a <nav> landmark.
findings.fix: Use a semantic <nav> element.

routed: Screen reader pass (D5): are elements announced sensibly and is the task completable?
Keyboard pass (D5): reachability, visible focus in practice, logical order.
Reading order and label comprehension in context (D3).
Touch/click target sizes ≥ 24×24 px measured as rendered (2.5.8).
Contrast verified against actual rendered backgrounds and images (1.4.3/1.4.11).
source.note: Automated detection covers the machine detectable layer of AITL only; contextual judgments are routed to human and assistive-technology-user review by design.
